reviews.author: Dae Dae
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this towing company. Their response time was impressively fast, and the driver was professional, courteous, and very knowledgeable. My vehicle was handled with care, and the whole process was smooth and stress-free. I especially appreciated how clear the pricing was upfront, no surprises at all. Highly recommend for anyone needing reliable and efficient towing service!

reviews.author: Thomas Heaney
reviews.text: Brandon saved my car from falling down a ditch, we called the insurance company and they were working on it but Brandon was literally right across the street from where my car got stuck, assuming he just got back from work it was around 8 PM, he so kindly helped us out and was able to get my car back on the road without ANY damage. I don’t know if I’d have my car right now if it weren’t for Brandon, saved the day and my car, very thankful for him.

reviews.author: Alma Dillon
reviews.text: Super quick response and made a stressful situation way easier. Brandon was professional, efficient, and took great care of my car. Really appreciated the help, highly recommend!

reviews.author: Monica Mattson
reviews.text: Wow! In an emotionally challenging time after a car wreck, Davis Towing was a beacon of hope that everything will be all right. I had a particularly terrible experience with another company and contacted Davis Towing in a desperate situation (neighbors were beginning to complain to the police about the "abandoned" car on the street, and the other company was promising to send, but not sending, a tow truck). Davis Towing was communicative, professional, knowledgeable, polite, and timely. The car was towed within 2 hours of my initial contact. A special thanks to Brandon for doing a terrific job!

reviews.author: ken hutchens
reviews.text: I highly recommend Daniel Davis Towing to anyone needing their services! I had my car back in my driveway within one hour of calling them. Very professional, courteous, and a good price. I esp. want to thank the driver, Brandon for the quick response, and very friendly and helpful attitude he had. I will use this company again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Eva Linex
reviews.text: He pulled my poor Jeep, that incidentally save my daughter's life and kept her belongings safe until we were able to retrieve them. He's and his business are Aces in my book. Great business and special Kudos to Steve

reviews.author: April Desourdy
reviews.text: Donny, the driver was friendly, he told us the total cost up front for all that was involved. Great price and showed up within a reasonable time frame. Highly recommended Daniel Davis Towing Co. to anyone.

reviews.author: Corey W
reviews.text: They towed my car that wouldn't start to a local repair shop. Service was timely and they had the best prices I could find.

reviews.author: Jeff Everhart
reviews.text: Thanks to Steve for responding quickly within 30 minutes to tow my Trailblazer to a shop to have fuel pump replaced. Will definitely call Daniel Davis Towing for all of my towing services. Courtesy and professional.

reviews.author: Michael Jones
reviews.text: Steve was very polite, helpful and very quick to arrive to help my wife and son retrieve the car out of the woods. I highly recommend Daniel Davis Towing and Recovery. M. Jones

reviews.author: Travis (T. Lucas)
reviews.text: Horrible I was in a wreck and what tow company closes on a Friday. And dont open up until Tuesday like my wallet in there and my car seats I begged the weekemd dispatch to let me get my stuff and he said no even tho he said that he still in the process of towing cars there but he can't let me get my stuff. U will wait untill they are ready for u to get your stuff is what he pretty much said with an attititude very unprofessional. I will not recommend this place at all

reviews.author: Brian Burleson
reviews.text: Steve was the driver to come pick up my truck in the middle of the road. He was very professional and he was quick about getting to me!!! I highly recommend Daniel Davis Towing to anyone!!!! Thanks guys

reviews.author: turtlespirit74
reviews.text: We were very happy with the fast, friendly service we received when we had to call for a tow truck. We were really impressed with the professionalism of this business. I would definitely recommend Daniel Davis towing.

reviews.author: Amber Burleson
reviews.text: Thanks to my friends at Daniel Davis for helping me when my car broke down. Steve got to me quickly and went above and beyond to take care of me.

reviews.author: Carla Kiser
reviews.text: I want to give a shout out to Brandon!!! He is most helpful, respectful and honest!!! Thank you Brandon for coming to my rescue!!! Keep up the good work!!!

reviews.author: Jerone Mcilwain
reviews.text: They were fast to respond.Handled vehicle well and quickly.I'm very pleased with the service and help they done for me.Thank you

reviews.author: Lyric Vick
reviews.text: they advertise being open 24/7 but are only open Monday through Friday 8-5. if you need to get items out your car you won't be able to. they should post their actual business hours because they are NOT open 24/7

reviews.author: Dillon Hicks
reviews.text: Drivers were very polite and helpful. Office staff was top notch, couldnt ask for any better service from drivers or staff!

reviews.author: Annette Gilmore
reviews.text: These guys went out of their way to help me this evening as I was a crazy emotional mess. Thanks for the extra service!
